thread:
rachael: OK team — planning the welcome micro-journey for the product launch next week. goal: get new signups to 1st meaningful action within 72h. short drip, clear CTA, low friction.
Diego: love it. propose two paths: trialers -> product-first emails (quickstart + tips), inbound leads -> value-story + webinar invite.
Sam: +1. also want a tiny VIP path for high-intent demos (lead score >= 80) — faster cadence and rep handoff.
Rachael: agree. can we keep total email count to 3 over 7 days for general cohort, 4 for trialers, 2 for VIPs (rep-run)?
Matt: yes. send windows: NA/EU midday; APAC send prior evening local time. we'll schedule via ESP timezone routing.
Sam: segment rules draft (for dev):
```sql
SELECT user_id FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND (utm_source = 'launch' OR referrer = 'blog')
  AND email_opt_in = true
  AND demo_requested = false;
```
Rachael: nice. add suppression for "no-marketing" and recent bounce. also exclude customers in onboarding.
Campaign-bot: Reminder: deliverability check queued. SPF/DKIM pass. Warmup: IP pool 3 at 75% capacity.
Diego: Subject line tests — we should A/B two angles: 1) "Welcome — quickstart in 5 minutes" 2) "See Redwood Inference in action: live tips + sample prompts". keep preheader under 90 chars.
Sam: CTA variants: Primary button -> "Start tutorial" vs "Try a sample prompt". track clicks per cohort.
Rachael: conversion metric = click -> in-app first action within 72h. secondary metric = webinar signups from inbound path.
Matt: operational ops: who owns the content? diego you + design pairing on assets. sam to set up segment queries and ESP flows. I'll handle send windows & suppression lists.
Diego: I'll draft copy today and drop in Figma link. need 2 small screenshots and a 20s GIF of the quickstart.
Sam: timeline: copy & assets ready by Thu EOD, QA send Fri morning, ramp scheduled Sat (APAC) / Sun (NA/EU).
Rachael: tagging follow-ups: @diego asset link, @sam confirm ESP flow names, @matt add send windows to the calendar invite.
Matt: added send slots and a short checklist to the launch calendar.
Campaign-bot: Deliverability check passing for domain redwood-inference.com (SPF/DKIM), recommended warmup pace: +20k/day over next 3 days.
Rachael: small risk note — for high-volume inbound we may want to throttle webinar invites to avoid rate-limited paths. we'll add a queue cap of 500/day for that invite.
Sam: will implement queue cap in ESP. will also add an exclude flag for 'recently emailed_48h'.
Diego: copy draft posted: https://app.design/xxx (comments welcome). keeping tone concise, product-forward.
Rachael: perfect. final checklist: copy approved, assets linked, segments created, ESP flows mapped, send windows set, deliverability pass, queue caps live. who wants to run post-send metric check on Day+2?
Sam: I'll take Day+1 deliverability & opens. diego can own Day+2 behavioral conversion.
Rachael: great — thanks everyone. we'll reconvene Fri morning for QA sign-off. :rocket:
